bug_semantics: An authenticated WordPress administrator can submit a download_path such as WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/../..'. The validation compares the uncanonicalized string prefix with WP_CONTENT_DIR, so the traversal-bearing string passes even though filesystem resolution escapes wp-content. The value is persisted as the plugin's filesystem root; download-add.php and download-manager.php pass that root to the recursive print_list_files()/print_list_folders() browser, allowing the administrator to enumerate files outside wp-content and select them for management/access.
flaw_origin: Commit a141c14127eb8d72413ac6a11dd3e7ad66aef9b1 added the advisory-specific containment check in download-options.php using substr($download_path, 0, strlen(WP_CONTENT_DIR)) on the raw path. It neither canonicalized the candidate nor rejected traversal components, so it first wrote the flawed prefix-check mechanism later replaced by the fix. Before this hardening commit the setting had no containment check at all; that explains the advisory description's broader 'all versions' exposure, but the specific traversal-bypass predicate named by the advisory originates in a141c14127eb8d72413ac6a11dd3e7ad66aef9b1.
ai_marker: absent: `git cat-file commit a141c14127eb8d72413ac6a11dd3e7ad66aef9b1` shows human author and committer `Lester Chan <lesterchan@gmail.com>` and the sole message `Ensure that Download Path starts only with your wp-content folder for additional security.`; there is no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI-tool/session trailer, or bot identity in the BIC commit object.
evidence: Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q7wp-4j7p-g4vj identifies CVE-2026-2419/CWE-22, administrator privileges, download_path, traversal bypass of the WP_CONTENT_DIR prefix check, affected through 1.69, and references https://github.com/lesterchan/wp-downloadmanager/commit/416b9f5459496166c0395f9e055d4c4cf872404a. Fix: `git show 416b9f5459496166c0395f9e055d4c4cf872404a` replaces the raw substr check in download-options.php:42 with realpath() of the candidate and WP_CONTENT_DIR plus rejection of false resolution and `../`; the commit message is `Don't allow Path Traversal`. Attack path at fix parent d3470a8971d9043438c8aad281cf37d14fefa208: download-options.php:16 receives/sanitizes POST download_path, line 42 performs the flawed raw prefix test, and line 48 persists it; download-add.php:11 and download-manager.php:13 load the option, while wp-downloadmanager.php:738-829 recursively opens the configured root and prints files/folders. Origin: `git log -L 42,44:download-options.php d3470a8971d9043438c8aad281cf37d14fefa208` attributes all three flawed check lines to a141c14127eb8d72413ac6a11dd3e7ad66aef9b1; `git log -S 'substr( $download_path, 0, strlen( WP_CONTENT_DIR ) )' -- download-options.php` returns only a141c14127eb8d72413ac6a11dd3e7ad66aef9b1 (addition) and 416b9f5459496166c0395f9e055d4c4cf872404a (removal). Parent absence: `git diff 8f3fdbd15b09494e3ceedf059c3286fab2af8b44 a141c14127eb8d72413ac6a11dd3e7ad66aef9b1 -- download-options.php` shows the raw-prefix validation as a new block, and exact `git grep -F` in 8f3fdbd15b09494e3ceedf059c3286fab2af8b44 exits 1; the parent instead proceeds directly from option construction to update_option(). Version boundary: a141c14127eb8d72413ac6a11dd3e7ad66aef9b1 sets README stable tag, plugin Version, and WP_DOWNLOADMANAGER_VERSION to 1.68.11; release commit f4f8687f0b16c948f54216e8030a6d28b8da3979 is version 1.69 and still contains the flawed check; fix 416b9f5459496166c0395f9e055d4c4cf872404a reports version/stable tag 1.69.1, and `git rev-list -n 1 1.69.1` resolves exactly to the fix. BIC object: `git cat-file commit a141c14127eb8d72413ac6a11dd3e7ad66aef9b1` supplies the author/committer/message and no AI trailer.
reasoning: The lifecycle is: unrestricted download_path configuration existed historically; a141c14127eb8d72413ac6a11dd3e7ad66aef9b1 attempted to impose the wp-content boundary for 1.68.11 but encoded containment as a lexical prefix check; a path beginning with the expected bytes and then traversing upward therefore passed and became the recursive file browser root; the same code remained in 1.69; 416b9f5459496166c0395f9e055d4c4cf872404a directly fixed the advisory-referenced check for 1.69.1 by resolving paths and rejecting traversal. For the advisory's precise mechanism, a141c14127eb8d72413ac6a11dd3e7ad66aef9b1 is the smallest BIC: line history and pickaxe converge on it, it is a single-parent substantive change rather than a move/revert/release-only commit, and its immediate parent lacks the flawed check. The earlier no-check state accounts for equivalent exposure in older versions but is not the first writer of the named WP_CONTENT_DIR-prefix-bypass logic. AI attribution is decided only from the a141c14127eb8d72413ac6a11dd3e7ad66aef9b1 commit object, which is human-authored/committed and contains no AI marker, so the closed verdict is NOT_AI.
